Sound more like the speakers you listen to.

Euno Shadowing is a daily coach for shadowing: pick a short clip, speak along with it, and see your melody and timing next to the speaker’s. Fifteen minutes a day, and your accent moves.

Start practising with GoogleHow it works

Free. Works in your browser. Your videos and recordings go to your own Google Drive, not our server.

A 15-minute session, done for you

Each session works on one clip of one or two sentences. Euno loops it, counts your passes and keeps the time, so all you do is listen and speak.

  1. Listen

    2 min. Hear the clip three times without speaking. Notice the rhythm and where the voice rises and falls.

  2. Shadow

    7 min. Speak along with the speaker, about 15 passes, no transcript. Copy everything: rhythm, melody and sounds.

  3. Record and compare

    2 min. Record one pass and play it next to the original. Check your pitch line and your lag.

  4. Shadow again

    4 min. About 8 more passes, then a final recording to compare with the first one.

Short on time? Bad-day mode runs a five-minute version, so you never have to skip a day. Every duration and pass count is a setting.

You choose the speaker. Euno runs the practice.

Euno Shadowing is a practice tool, not a course. It doesn’t come with lessons, so the voice you copy is one you picked.

Shadow your own videos

  • Upload a video or audio file, or paste a link to an .mp4, then cut a clip of one or two sentences.
  • Pick any speaker whose accent you want: an interviewee, a podcaster, a speaker you admire.
  • There are no built-in lessons, subtitles or transcripts. The routine, timer, recording and comparison are what Euno adds.

AI feedback, if you want it

  • Write down what sounded off in a recording, and ask an AI for feedback on it.
  • It uses your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter, so you choose the model and pay the provider directly.
  • No key, or no AI at all? Everything else works the same.

See how your recording compares

This is the comparison view. Each recording is drawn over the speaker’s, so you can see what changed between your first attempt and your last.

  • Your melody next to theirs. Both lines are measured relative to each speaker’s own voice, so a higher or lower voice doesn’t matter.
  • Your lag. Euno lines the recordings up and tells you how far behind or ahead of the speaker you were.
  • First recording against the last. Play them one after the other, or both together, and hear the change.

Everything a shadowing routine needs

Clips from any video

Add a video, then drag on the timeline to cut a clip. A zoomed waveform helps you trim exactly at the pauses.

See your melody

Pitch tracking draws the speaker’s intonation and yours, each relative to its own voice, so you can see where you go flat.

Measure your lag

After each pass, Euno aligns your recording with the clip and tells you how far behind or ahead you were.

Record and compare

Play the original, yourself, one after the other or both together. Your step 3 and final recordings are kept for every clip.

Notes that find patterns

Write down what sounded off. Recurring problems collect into an issues list, so you know what to target next.

12-week check-ins

Record a baseline, then check in at weeks 4, 8 and 12 with the same tasks, and hear how far you’ve come.

Your voice stays yours

Your files, in your own Drive

  • Videos and voice recordings go into a “Euno Shadowing” folder in your own Google Drive, so they’re on every device you sign in on.
  • The app can only see the files it puts there, and our server never stores them.
  • Our server only keeps your practice notes, settings and progress, and you can export or delete them any time.

AI feedback with your own key, if you want it

  • Bring a key from Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter and pick the model, from cheap and fast to the most capable.
  • Your key is encrypted on our server and never shown again, not even to you.
  • No key? Euno writes the prompt for you to paste into any chatbot.

Questions

The short answers. The guides go deeper on what shadowing is and the daily routine.

Something else? Send us a message.

What is shadowing?

Shadowing means speaking along with a recording at the same time as the speaker, copying their rhythm, melody and sounds as closely as you can. It trains the way you speak, not just the way you understand. Read the full guide.

Does it cost anything?

No. Euno Shadowing is free. AI feedback is optional and uses your own API key, so any AI usage is billed to you directly by the provider you pick, and you choose the model.

Which languages and accents does it support?

You can practise English (General Australian, General American or Southern British), French (Parisian or Québécois) or Spanish (Mexican, Spain or Rioplatense), or name another accent of those languages. The app itself is available in English, French and Spanish. More languages, such as Japanese and German, are planned.

Where are my videos and recordings stored?

In your own Google Drive. When you connect it, the app puts your files in a “Euno Shadowing” folder there, so they’re on every device you sign in on, and it can only see the files it creates. Your browser also keeps a copy of the files you open so they play instantly. Our server only keeps your practice notes and progress, never the audio or video.

Which videos can I use?

Any video or audio file you have the right to use for your own practice: upload a file from your device or paste a direct link to an .mp4. Interviews, podcasts and talks with one clear speaker work best.

Does Euno come with lessons, videos or transcripts?

No. You shadow your own videos: upload a file from your device or paste a link, then cut the clips you want to practise. Euno has no lesson library, subtitles or transcripts of its own. It runs the shadowing routine on your clips and compares your voice with the speaker’s.

Do I need an AI key?

No. Everything works without one. With a key from Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter, you can ask for feedback on what sounded off in your recording. Without a key, Euno writes the prompt for you to paste into any chatbot.

Do I need a microphone?

Yes, for recording passes and check-ins. A headset or earphones help, so the speaker’s voice doesn’t leak into your recording.
